procedure_oil.question: How often is transformer oil sampled?
procedure_oil.answer:
Distribution and traction transformers are sampled annually for dissolved gas analysis [rail-001]. 

If hydrogen levels exceed 150 ppm or if any acetylene is detected, a confirmation sample must be taken within 30 days [rail-001]. Oil should not be topped up before sampling, as this dilution can mask the presence of fault gases [rail-001].
